svg.title: Platform schema
svg.desc: The workspace row with its versioned configuration, logo and demo clock; platform master data with its per-kind versions and the outbox; outbound webhooks and their deliveries; browser errors and their resolved groups; and the audit trail, audit subjects and the legacy audit log, in the platform schema of the workspace database. Only workspace_config references workspace with a foreign key.
svg.text: NOT DRAWN processed_events, dead_events (standard shapes) · workspace_config.config.timezone is projected into the other modules' workspace_settings
